title: Reading Practice Test 09 – Conferences & Events
description: Đề luyện Reading theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 28 câu: Part 5 (10) · Part 6 (4, có câu điền cả câu) · Part 7 (14: tờ rơi sự kiện, e-mail thay đổi lịch, bài báo có chèn câu, đoạn kép). Chủ đề: hội nghị, diễn giả, đăng ký sự kiện.

questions.content: Registration for the annual technology conference will close ------- all seats have been filled.
questions.explanation: Cần liên từ nối mệnh đề với nghĩa 'ngay khi' → 'once'. Các lựa chọn khác là giới từ.

questions.content: The keynote speaker's presentation was both informative and -------.
questions.explanation: Song song với tính từ 'informative'; bài thuyết trình 'mang tính giải trí' → 'entertaining' (-ing mô tả tính chất sự vật).

questions.content: Attendees who ------- in advance will receive a 15% discount.
questions.explanation: Động từ của mệnh đề quan hệ, chủ ngữ 'Attendees' số nhiều → 'register'.

questions.content: The seminar has been ------- to the larger hall because of high demand.
questions.explanation: Bị động hoàn thành 'has been + V3' → 'moved'.

questions.content: Lunch will be served in the main lobby ------- noon and 1:30 P.M.
questions.explanation: 'between … and …' = trong khoảng giữa hai mốc. 'from' phải đi với 'to'.

questions.content: The event organizers ------- a record number of participants this year.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ số nhiều 'organizers' cần động từ chia đúng → 'are expecting'. 'expects' dùng cho số ít.

questions.content: Speakers must submit ------- presentation slides to the technical team by Monday.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu phù hợp với chủ ngữ số nhiều 'Speakers' → 'their'.

questions.content: The conference center is ------- accessible by public transportation.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'accessible' → 'easily accessible' (dễ dàng đi tới).

questions.content: Please let us know ------- you will attend the networking dinner on Friday.
questions.explanation: 'let us know whether…' = cho biết liệu có… hay không (mệnh đề danh từ).

questions.content: The workshop was canceled ------- the instructor was ill.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề 'the instructor was ill' → liên từ 'because'. 'due to' + danh từ.

groups.passage:
Dear Dr. Watanabe,

Thank you for agreeing to speak at the International Health Innovation Forum on November 14. Your session, "The Future of Remote Patient Care," ---131--- for 2:00 P.M. in Room B.

Please arrive at least 30 minutes before your session so that our technical staff can help you set up. A laptop, projector, and wireless microphone will be ---132---. ---133---.

We have reserved a room for you at the Grand Harbor Hotel, which is connected to the conference center. Your stay will be covered by the forum. ---134---, please keep all receipts for taxis and meals so that we can reimburse you.

Sincerely,
Emily Ross
Speaker Coordinator

questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ 'Your session' là vật được sắp xếp → bị động 'is scheduled for + thời gian'.
Bị động 'will be + V3' (sẽ được cung cấp) → 'provided'.

options.A: The forum was founded ten years ago.
options.B: Hotel prices are lower in summer.
options.C: If you plan to show a video, please let us know in advance.
options.D: Please return your badge after lunch.

questions.explanation: Đoạn đang nói về thiết bị trình chiếu → câu chèn liên quan: báo trước nếu định chiếu video.
Sau chi phí khách sạn được chi trả, câu tiếp bổ sung thêm việc hoàn tiền taxi, ăn uống → 'In addition'.

groups.passage:
Riverside Business Breakfast
Thursday, September 19 · 7:30–9:00 A.M.
Riverside Community Center, Room 3

Guest speaker: Carlos Mendez, founder of GreenCup Coffee, will talk about growing a small business in a competitive market.

Tickets: $25 for members, $35 for non-members, breakfast included.
Seating is limited. Reserve by September 12 at riversidebiz.org.

questions.content: Who is Carlos Mendez?
questions.explanation: 'Carlos Mendez, founder of GreenCup Coffee' → người sáng lập công ty.

questions.content: What is indicated about the tickets?

options.B: They are sold at the door only.
options.D: They are free for new members.

questions.explanation: Hội viên trả $25, người ngoài trả $35. (C) sai – đã bao gồm bữa sáng.

groups.passage:
To: Registered Attendees
From: Global Retail Summit
Date: April 2
Subject: Important update

Dear Attendee,

We are writing to inform you of a change to the Global Retail Summit program. Due to a scheduling conflict, Ms. Aiko Tanaka, CEO of Sakura Stores, will now deliver her keynote address on Day 2, April 16, instead of Day 1, April 15. Her talk will begin at 9:00 A.M. in the Grand Ballroom.

The panel discussion originally scheduled for Day 2 will move to Day 1 at the same time and location.

All other sessions remain unchanged. The updated program is available on our mobile app. We apologize for any inconvenience and look forward to seeing you in Chicago.

Sincerely,
The Global Retail Summit Team

questions.content: Why was the e-mail sent?

options.A: To announce a change in a program
options.D: To request feedback on an event

questions.explanation: '…to inform you of a change to the Global Retail Summit program.'

questions.content: When will Ms. Tanaka give her talk?
questions.explanation: '…will now deliver her keynote address on Day 2, April 16.'

questions.content: Where can attendees find the revised schedule?
questions.explanation: 'The updated program is available on our mobile app.'

groups.passage:
Hybrid Conferences Here to Stay
By Grace Liu

When the Pacific Tech Expo returned to Vancouver last fall, organizers noticed something unexpected: almost 40 percent of attendees chose to watch online rather than travel to the event. [1] As a result, the expo now offers both in-person and virtual tickets.

Many event planners say this hybrid model allows them to reach a much wider audience. [2] Virtual tickets typically cost less, making events more accessible to students and small businesses. However, hybrid events also bring new challenges. Organizers must invest in high-quality cameras, reliable internet connections, and staff to manage online participants. [3]

"It's like running two events at the same time," said Daniel Okafor, director of the Pacific Tech Expo. [4] Still, he believes the benefits outweigh the costs.

questions.content: What is the article mainly about?

options.A: A new convention center in Vancouver
options.B: Events offered both in person and online
options.C: The rising price of conference tickets

questions.explanation: Bài viết về mô hình hội nghị kết hợp (hybrid) – vừa trực tiếp vừa trực tuyến.

questions.content: What is mentioned as an advantage of virtual tickets?
questions.explanation: 'Virtual tickets typically cost less, making events more accessible…'

questions.content: The word "outweigh" in paragraph 3, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: 'the benefits outweigh the costs' = lợi ích lớn hơn chi phí → exceed.

questions.content:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Some speakers have also found it difficult to engage audiences they cannot see."
questions.explanation: Câu chèn nêu thêm một thách thức ('also'), nối tiếp đoạn liệt kê khó khăn của sự kiện hybrid → vị trí [3].

groups.passage:
Northeast Nursing Conference – Boston, June 6–8

Registration Rates
• Full conference, 3 days: Early rate $450 (until April 30) · Regular rate $550
• Single day: $220
• Student rate, full conference (valid ID required): $180

Workshops on June 8 require separate registration, cost $40 each, and are limited to 25 participants.

Hotel: Conference attendees can receive a discounted rate of $159 per night at the Harborview Hotel by booking before May 15.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

To: registration@nenursing.org
From: Paul Greene
Date: May 3
Subject: Registration question

Hello,

I registered for the full conference on May 1 and paid $550. I recently learned that I could have received a lower rate as a student. I am currently enrolled in a master's program in nursing at Hartford University. Would it be possible to receive a refund of the difference? I can send a copy of my student ID.

I would also like to sign up for the workshop on patient communication on June 8. Could you tell me if there are still spaces available?

Thank you,
Paul Greene

questions.content: What is indicated about the workshops?

options.B: They are open to students only.
options.C: They take place at the Harborview Hotel.

questions.explanation: 'Workshops… require separate registration, cost $40 each' → tốn thêm phí.

questions.content: What is suggested about Mr. Greene's registration?

options.A: It was completed after the early-rate deadline.
options.B: It was for a single day.
options.D: It was paid by his university.

questions.explanation: Anh đăng ký ngày 1/5 và trả $550 (giá thường) – sau hạn giá sớm 30/4.

questions.content: How much money does Mr. Greene hope to get back?
questions.explanation: Anh muốn hoàn phần chênh lệch giữa giá đã trả ($550) và giá sinh viên ($180): $550 − $180 = $370.

questions.content: What does Mr. Greene offer to provide?

options.D: Proof that he is a student

questions.explanation: 'I can send a copy of my student ID.'

questions.content: What is suggested about the workshop Mr. Greene wants to attend?

options.C: It has a limited number of spaces.
options.D: It is held at the Harborview Hotel.

questions.explanation: Hội thảo nhỏ vào 8/6 giới hạn 25 người – vì vậy anh hỏi còn chỗ không (kết hợp hai đoạn).
